entities.name: KIT receptor
observations: The 768-aa query has a 100% identity, 100% query-coverage match to reviewed Xenopus laevis Kit receptor-related protein Q91909 (query_protein result call_kowb1lKaaTK8ATEMVbJSe7Pv).

Reviewed homolog annotation identifies a KITLG/SCF receptor with transmembrane receptor protein-tyrosine kinase activity; it is a single-pass cell-membrane protein (query_protein result call_kowb1lKaaTK8ATEMVbJSe7Pv).

Reported biological roles include KIT signaling, cell survival and proliferation, hematopoiesis, stem-cell maintenance, gametogenesis, mast-cell development/function, melanogenesis, and cell migration (query_protein result call_kowb1lKaaTK8ATEMVbJSe7Pv).
Query Pfam hits include Ig_PDGFR_d4 and protein kinase domains, consistent with extracellular receptor and intracellular kinase regions (query_protein result call_kowb1lKaaTK8ATEMVbJSe7Pv).
